annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I can tell they feel foolish for trusting me
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: probably watching the door, expecting me to walk in any minute
annotations.ce_understood_harm: they lose both the work and the fairness they counted on
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: losing a friendship over $250, which costs far more than it saves

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: thinking I don't value their time
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since I let them carry the whole job while I collected half
annotations.ce_understood_harm: not just money but the sense that I have their back
annotations.pda_responsibility: I let them carry the whole job while I collected half the pay
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Showing up protects something worth more than one paycheck

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: maybe wondering if I ever intended to help at all
annotations.ce_understood_harm: That kind of doubt about a person you trusted is its own quiet injury
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: choosing a short-term gain for myself over their peace of mind
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: The math there doesn't favor disappearing twice.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: My friend likely feels taken advantage of
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: since they did the labor while I profited from their effort
annotations.ce_understood_harm: That's a real cost to them
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: one job's inconvenience matters less than losing someone who trusted me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: someone who feels foolish for believing in me
annotations.ce_understood_harm: They already lost time and effort once for nothing.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: betting a friendship against convenience, and that's a bad trade

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: understandable given what they were counting on
annotations.ce_understood_harm: their effort, their patience, maybe the friendship itself
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: costs me nothing compared to what they'd lose if I skipped again

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: That's got to breed some resentment, maybe even embarrassment
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: embarrassment at having vouched for me to the owner
annotations.ce_understood_harm: what they lost — time, energy, trust
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: the only way to balance the scale, even partially

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: wondering why they bothered trusting me
annotations.ce_understood_harm: They lost hours and got nothing extra for it
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: the partnership wins — it costs more to lose than to give

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: someone who feels foolish for extending trust
annotations.ce_understood_harm: They lost real time and possibly some faith in people
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: abandoning it twice would make the loss permanent instead of repairable
annotations.pda_repair_intention: If I want that trust rebuilt, showing up next job

annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: having put in the actual labor while I walked away with equal pay
annotations.sys_fairness_reciprocity: equal pay for none of it. That imbalance is hard to ignore
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: one job's effort from me could start repairing what's already been strained
